name: Stripe
description: Connect your own Stripe account (via your own secret or restricted API key) to manage payments from Imperal -- customers, payment intents, charges, refunds, payment methods, products, prices, subscriptions, invoices, checkout sessions, payment links, coupons and promotion codes, balance and payouts, disputes, Connect accounts and transfers, webhook endpoints, events, tax rates, setup intents, plus revenue/health rollups and bulk operations. Nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself -- your key, your account, your fees.

tools.name: connect_stripe
tools.description: Connect your own Stripe account by saving your Secret Key or Restricted Key, after checking it actually works. Get a key from Stripe Dashboard > Developers > API keys. A Restricted Key scoped to just what you need is recommended over the full Secret Key.

api_key.description: Your Stripe Secret Key (sk_live_.../sk_test_...) or, preferably, a Restricted Key (rk_live_.../rk_test_...) scoped to what you want this connector to do. Found in Stripe Dashboard > Developers > API keys.

pricing.notes: Standard platform scale {0,8,16,20,40,60} per PRICING_POLICY.md -- Stripe is not a Google-backed API so no x1.8 markup applies. 0: connection lifecycle (connect/disconnect/list_connections) -- setup/teardown of credentials, not an operation against the Stripe API. 8: any list_*/get_*/verify_webhook_signature -- simple read of external state. 16: standard single-entity create/update/delete/set action. 20: heavier single actions that actually move money right now or apply a real-world side effect immediately (confirm/capture payment intent, pay_invoice, create_payout, create_transfer). 40: aggregate value-add reports scanning many objects in one call (revenue report, dunning report).
